notes.title: v1.0.5 Controller Support Is Here!
notes.content:
Yes, Mecha-Tokyo Rush's most requested feature is now here. Full controller support as well as customization are now here!

[b]v1.0.5[/b]
• Cursor can now be controlled with Keyboard Arrow Keys, Controller Left Analog Stick, and Controller D-Pad.
• "Jump", "Fire", and "Pause" commands can now be customized from the Options screen.
• Music and Effects volumes can now be customized from the Options screen.
• Full Screen and Windowed modes can now be toggled from the Options screen (and can be toggled at any time with the F10 key).
• Increased the damage done by T.SALVO.
• Reduced the damage done by D.TORPEDO.
• Some minor graphical changes.

(Controller support was tested with an X-Box 360 controller, PS4 controller, and NES controller with Tomee USB adapter)

notes.title: v1.0.4 Bug Fix
notes.content:
v1.0.4
• Fixxed a glitch from v1.0.3 that caused the Menu theme to play during the game without loading the Level or Boss themes, and various other loading errors.

notes.title: v1.0.3 Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Thanks for the feedback, everyone! We're trying as quickly as possible to fix glitches and add features.

v1.0.3
• Fixed various text rendering glitches.
• The difficulty select buttons no longer function before selecting a level.
• M.MISSEL will now prioritizes the active mask during the Menreiki boss fight.
• K.SLASH can now reach the Blue Mask during the Menreiki boss fight.
• Weapons no longer effect Spikes.
• "Delete" key no longer closes the game.

An additional note:
Several people requested adding an "auto-fire" to the game. However, if you select Tera from the character select, she already has auto-fire as her default weapon.

notes.title: v1.0.2 Now in Brazilian Portuguese!
notes.content:
Mecha-Tokyo Rush has seen a huge amount of unexpected support in Brazil! So, starting with v1.0.2 the game will be available with Brazilian Portuguese. If your device is set to "Portuguese", it will load by default. But, if not, you can select "Portuguese (BR)" from the options screen.

v1.0.2
• Added "Portuguese (BR)" to the language options.
• Fixed several graphical glitches.
